requirements.description: Use stable tasks/new routes and one fixed page-level navigation
Disable configuration until the operator explicitly selects a read-only production dataset
Identify video duration, its purpose, and the duration-column source
Filter cases by status, issue type, and Case ID with filter-scoped bulk confirmation
Use compact rows and a responsive detail dialog with saved drafts and explicit re-preflight
Run full regression, desktop/mobile browser checks, and no-paid-generation safety validation
Fast-forward GitHub main and verify CI plus dev deployment
